item.title: Faint black lines on nails: Harmless or sign of aggressive skin cancer? Reddit post goes viral
item.description: A woman who shared a photo of faint black lines on her thumb and toe nails on Reddit was urged to see a doctor after commenters warned the marks can sometimes indicate melanoma. Medical sources say such lines, known as melanonychia, are often harmless but can signal aggressive skin cancer, highlighting the importance of professional assessment rather than online diagnosis.

item.title: “Blackballing people”: Candace Owens revives Kanye West tweet while blasting The Daily Wire over treatment and control
item.description: Candace Owens has renewed her public fight with The Daily Wire by pointing to an old Kanye West tweet about being blackballed. In a new podcast video, Owens said his words now reflect her own experience with the company. She also questioned why her old content was brought back online without her involvement.

item.title: Minneapolis shooting: The heart-rending poem that ICE victim Renee Nicole Good wrote
item.description: Renee Nicole Good, a 37-year-old poet and mother, was fatally shot by a US Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer during an operation in south Minneapolis. Officials quickly deemed the shooting justified, though an investigation was announced. Good was an award-winning writer, recognized in 2020 for her poem 'On Learning to Dissect Fetal Pigs.'

item.title: MrBeast says his wedding to Thea Booysen will be private and off-camera
item.description: YouTuber MrBeast, real name Jimmy Donaldson, has confirmed his upcoming wedding to fiancée Thea Booysen will be a private affair, with no plans for online content. After over a year of quiet planning, the couple aims for an intimate ceremony, possibly on an island, prioritizing quality time away from his typically public online life.

item.title: Candace Owens raises new questions about Charlie Kirk after revealing a never before seen image with no visible blood
item.description: Candace Owens shared claims about a photo she says shows Charlie Kirk after an alleged shooting. She questioned the official story and named people she said could not be trusted. However, there is no verified evidence, police record, or official confirmation that Charlie Kirk was shot or killed. Her statements remain unproven and widely disputed.

item.title: El Salvador’s prison factory: Thousands of inmates sew uniforms round the clock and earn sentence reductions
item.description: El Salvador's prisons are now buzzing with sewing machines, as inmates produce uniforms for public institutions. This state-backed program, part of a crackdown on gangs, offers work, training, and potential sentence reductions. Officials highlight its role in making prisons functional and reducing government spending, sparking international interest in similar reform models.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Is this Leonardo da Vinci’s DNA? Scientists may have finally found his genetic trace on Renaissance art
item.description: Scientists have recovered trace DNA from Renaissance drawings and letters linked to Leonardo da Vinci, using minimally invasive swabbing. The emerging field of arteomics reveals environmental and human genetic clues that may illuminate authorship and historical context. While some DNA aligns with Tuscan ancestry, researchers stress identity cannot be proven, highlighting both promise and limits of modern scientific inquiry today.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: “Pretend you’re an activist”: Brandon Tatum backs ICE after Renee Good is shot during Minneapolis operation
item.description: Brandon Tatum defended an ICE agent after Renee Nicole Good was fatally shot during a Minneapolis operation on January 7, 2026. DHS and Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem said the agent acted in self-defense. Donald Trump also backed ICE. Good’s family disputed claims, saying she was not part of violent protests.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Iran protests turn violent: Viral video shows moment protester drives car into security forces
item.description: Violent clashes erupted across Iran as anti-government protests, fueled by economic hardship and currency devaluation, entered their eleventh day. Reports indicate security forces used gunfire and tear gas against demonstrators, with videos showing a car ramming into officers. At least 34 protesters and four security personnel have been killed amidst widespread arrests.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘It’s my fault’: Is ICE shooting victim Renee Nicole Good’s partner responsible for her death — here’s what we know
item.description: A woman, Rebecca Good, sobbed "it's my fault" after her wife, Renee Nicole Good, was fatally shot by an ICE agent in Minneapolis. Renee drove at the officer during an ICE operation, leading to the shooting. The couple, new to Minneapolis from Kansas City, had a young child at school.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Candace Owens accuses Ben Shapiro of using her old podcast to publicly attack her after Daily Wire fallout
item.description: Candace Owens accused Ben Shapiro and The Daily Wire of using clips from her old podcast to attack her publicly. She shared her claims in a January 8, 2026 post on X and repeated concerns on her podcast. Owens said the resurfaced content feels intentional and compared the situation to a “crazy ex-stalker.”

item.title: Another strong-arm killing in polarized America inflames divisions
item.description: A shooting incident in Minneapolis involving an immigration enforcement agent and a woman has ignited fierce debate. Republicans claim self-defense against a resisting driver. Democrats and local officials dispute this, calling the agent trigger-happy. The event, near where George Floyd died, has intensified tensions in the city. The woman's family describes her as a devoted mother and poet.
